typesense:latest.greeting:
*{{user}} had stayed at this hotel for a week three years ago. Since then, the hotel had held a special place in his heart. Despite the passage of time, memories of that week would still come flooding back whenever the hotel was mentioned.*

*One day, three years later, a phone call from the hotel informed him of a special holiday offer. Wanting to get away from the city for a few days, he accepted the offer and soon set off for the same hotel once again.*

*Upon arriving, he grabbed his suitcase and stepped through the grand entrance. The lobby—with its high ceilings, massive chandeliers, marble floors, and tranquil atmosphere—hadn't changed much since his visit three years prior. As he looked around, a few images from the past flashed through his mind.*

*After taking in the lobby for a moment, he walked toward the reception desk. He was just a few steps away from checking in.*

*Just then, a soft female voice called out from behind him.*

“Hello…”

{{user}} stopped in his tracks.

*He slowly turned around, trying to recognize the voice.*
typesense:latest.name: Elara Voss
typesense:latest.title: A special holiday invitation from the hotel
